display.purpose: Hero and section headlines only, via .journiq-heading.

body.purpose: All running copy and UI text (Avenir Next stack).

label.purpose: Nav links, button labels, chip text — bold-to-black weight signals interactivity.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Field Journal primary button hover state only.

shadows.name: stack-depth
shadows.purpose: Featured story-card-stack on Field Journal routes - brand-tinted photo-depth effect.

shadows.name: stack-depth-night
shadows.purpose: Same stack inside .night-field - neutral-dark ink, since a forest-tinted shadow is invisible on the near-black ground.

shadows.name: panel-night
shadows.purpose: Raised panel on the Night Field home page (the destination-quiz card) - the only resting shadow in that world.

motion.name: focus-pull
motion.purpose: Night Field's one authored motion idea, for section heads and large blocks. Scroll-driven via animation-timeline: view().

motion.name: focus-pull-lift
motion.purpose: Same idea, shorter throw and no blur, for repeated rows (index entries, trust cards).

motion.name: hero-pull
motion.purpose: The load-time expression of the focus pull, staggered across hero headline, standfirst and CTAs.

motion.name: read-progress
motion.purpose: Reading hairline under the sticky header on the Night Field home page.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out; the default for Night Field state and entrance transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled pill CTA — 'Share your story', form submits.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e8794a; color: #24130e; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.13); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e8794a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined pill button — 'Sign in', ghost actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #1f2926; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(111,125,119,0.22); border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e8794a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Work-type / topic badge on story cards.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #dde8df; color: #2f6b57; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Attribution Chip
components.description: Contributor identity unit — initial avatar, name, trip metadata.
components.css: .ds-attribution { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-attribution-avatar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f5efe4; color: rgba(31,41,38,0.7); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-attribution-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-attribution-name { font-weight: 500; } .ds-attribution-meta { font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgba(31,41,38,0.6); display: flex; gap: 10px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Solid-state header nav with underline-on-hover links.
components.html: StoriesDestinationsAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #1f2926; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: -7px; height: 2px; background: #e8794a; transition: right 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { right: 0; }

components.name: Index Entry
components.description: One record in the archive index: numeral, thumbnail, title, and the fields the story actually carries.
components.html: • 04Raven — Dairy Farm in OamaruOamaru, Otago · Agriculture · 2026
components.css: .ds-nf-entry { list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); transition: background-color .3s ease, padding-left .3s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.28,1); } .ds-nf-entry:hover { background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 7%, transparent); padding-left: .75rem; } .ds-nf-entry a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3rem minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 0 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem 0; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nf-num { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .875rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 40%, transparent); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-nf-entry:hover .ds-nf-num { color: var(--accent); } .ds-nf-title { display: block; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.01em; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nf-entry:hover .ds-nf-title { color: var(--accent); } .ds-nf-meta { display: block; margin-top: .5rem; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .75rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: One value on an index filter axis. Pressed state fills with the accent.
components.css: .ds-nf-chip { border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: transparent; padding: .375rem .875rem; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 80%, transparent); transition: color .2s, border-color .2s, background-color .2s; } .ds-nf-chip:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nf-chip.is-on { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); }

narrative.overview: Kakinotes reads as a documentary archive shown in a darkened room. A near-black ground lets photography carry the light; one saturated cyan is the only voice raised above the neutrals, spent on state and emphasis rather than decoration. Structure is carried by hairline rules and mono numerals -- the vocabulary of a catalogue, not a marketing page. Both themes speak the same language: dark is the signature rendition, light its counterpart on a cool near-white ground.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with cool off-white ink, and one cyan accent used sparingly
Heavy sans throughout -- no serif anywhere; Geist Mono carries every numeral and column label
Flat, hairline-ruled surfaces at rest; shadow and lift only as a response to interaction
Full-pill buttons and chips; the primary button is ghost-outline first, filling on hover
Motion is one authored idea (a lens focus pull) in CSS scroll timelines, never JS observers

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Cyan is the only colour for CTAs and emphasis. Semantic status colours are permitted only in the staff moderation tools, where they carry meaning rather than brand.

rules.name: The Two Renditions Rule
rules.body: Every colour decision is made for both themes at once, and neither is an inversion of the other. A colour that only works on one ground needs a token with two values, not a dark: override.

rules.name: The One Switch Rule
rules.body: data-theme is the single theming signal; Tailwind's dark: variant is bound to it via @custom-variant. Never introduce a second signal.

rules.name: The No-Serif Rule
rules.body: There is no serif in this system. The Georgia display face belonged to the retired Field Journal palette.

rules.name: The Display-Clamp Rule
rules.body: .journiq-heading and .night-heading carry font-size clamps and are defined after Tailwind's utilities, so they win over a text-xl override at equal specificity. Use them for page and section headings only.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Record Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono marks data the reader can verify -- a position, a year, a place, a count. Never use it to make prose look technical.

rules.name: The Two Shapes Rule
rules.body: A row that becomes columns uses one grid, not two layouts: display:contents promotes the inner wrapper's children into the parent grid from md up. Never duplicate markup per breakpoint.

rules.name: The Rest-Is-Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing carries a shadow at rest except the story-card-stack and the quiz panel.

rules.name: The CSS-Timeline Rule
rules.body: Scroll-linked motion uses CSS animation-timeline, never a JS observer, gated behind @supports and prefers-reduced-motion so content is visible by default. Never reintroduce a reveal whose resting state is invisible.

rules.name: The Real Fields Rule
rules.body: Every index column is a field the record actually holds. A missing field is omitted, never a placeholder dash. Filter axes are built only from values present in the batch, and an axis renders only when it can split that batch.

rules.name: The Separate Axes Rule
rules.body: Place, Work and Topic are distinct filter axes. Never merge tags into the Work axis: it files 'South Island' as a kind of job.

dos: Do reserve Signal Cyan for CTAs, focus states, active filter chips, and the active-nav underline.
Do decide every colour for both themes at once, with a two-value token rather than a dark: override.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; shadow is for hover response, the story-card-stack, or the quiz panel.
Do use full-pill shape for any new interactive control at button/chip scale.
Do set numerals, counts, and record fields in Geist Mono.
Do gate new motion behind prefers-reduced-motion AND @supports (animation-timeline: view()).
donts: Don't add star ratings, review scores, purchase-style CTAs, traveller-count badges, or avatar-stack social proof.
Don't introduce a second accent colour competing with Signal Cyan.
Don't style a control with a hardcoded bg-black / dark:bg-white inversion; primary actions take bg-accent.
Don't reach for a raw text-red-* for errors; use text-destructive.
Don't add a persistent shadow to a surface at rest outside the two documented exceptions.
Don't reintroduce a scroll reveal that defaults to opacity: 0.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as an icon system.
Don't render a placeholder dash for a field a story does not carry.
